title: Compliance Evidence Workbench: Questionnaires, DPA Support & Audit Readiness
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem: Customers in regulated industries request a repeatable way to get evidence that Redwood's data residency and retention controls were applied to their tenant, plus a fast path for answering vendor questionnaires (security, DPA, SOC readiness) and an audit-request workflow. Current process is ad-hoc: Support fields tickets, Legal prepares manual DPA extracts, and Engineering runs ad-hoc queries. This is slow and error-prone for enterprise deals.

Goals:
- Provide a self-serve 'Compliance Evidence Workbench' in the Console that lets customers: download tenant-specific residency proof, export retention-policy history, and retrieve a DPA bundle with signed terms.
- Offer a guided questionnaire UI and export (PDF/zip) for common vendor security questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ-lite) populated with tenant metadata and references to our canonical policies.
- Create an audit-readiness workflow: intake ticket -> evidence bundle generation -> Legal confirmation -> delivery to customer (with RBAC/audit log).

Scope:
- In scope: Console UX for evidence bundle requests, backend job to assemble logs/config snapshots, automated generation of DPA package, questionnaire templates for SIG/CAIQ-lite, and an SLA for first response for enterprise customers.
- Out of scope: Full SOC2 attestation process and long-term SOC audit tooling (separate program).

Constraints & trade-offs:
- We cannot export raw production logs containing PII; evidence bundle must redact PII and include hashed identifiers or attestations derived from stored metadata.
- Automated exports should prioritize reproducible artifacts over raw data to avoid leaking customer data from other tenants.
- For speed to market we will support a small set of questionnaire templates and expand based on demand.

Proposed approach:
- UX: a new Console section "Compliance Workbench" where customer can select request type (residency proof, retention audit, questionnaire, DPA bundle, or full audit pack). Requests create a traceable work item with status updates and downloadable artifacts when ready.
- Backend: a jobs service (leveraging existing reporting infra) that collects immutable configs (tenant model pin, region, retention policy), KV cache snapshots (redacted), and signed attestations from Legal/Compliance.
- DPA support: templated DPA with dynamic insertion of tenant-specific controls and KMS region metadata; ability to attach executed DPA (post-signature) to tenant's workspace.
- Evidence & redaction rules: Eng and Security will define redaction policies (e.g., redact tokens, mask IPs) and acceptance criteria for what constitutes "evidence" vs "raw logs".

Stakeholders & reviewers:
- Legal: Priya Nambiar (DPA templates, signature flow)
- Security/Compliance: Jonah Park (redaction rules, attestations)
- Eng owners: Ravi Patel (reporting infra) and Sara Nguyen (console flows)
- Support & CSM: Liza Romero (customer comms, SLAs)

Deliverables (MVP):
- Console UI for submitting requests and viewing status
- Automated job to assemble and redact evidence bundles and produce zip/PDF output
- Three questionnaire templates (SIG-lite, CAIQ-lite, Vendor Security Checklist) with auto-filled fields and links to canonical docs
- DPA templating and attachable executed DPA metadata
- Audit log entries and email/webhook notifications for enterprise SAML/SO requests

Acceptance criteria and success metrics are below.

Links to artifacts and design sketches are in the updates/links fields below.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Customers can initiate a "Compliance Workbench" request in Console and see a work item created with status transitions.
2) Evidence bundle job runs end-to-end for residency and retention requests: produces a zip containing an index, redacted config snapshots, attestations, and a human-readable summary.
3) Questionnaire exports populate >=60% of SIG-lite fields from tenant metadata and include references to canonical docs.
4) DPA bundle generation inserts tenant-specific controls and provides a signed artifact placeholder (for Legal to upload final executed DPA).
5) All artifacts are recorded in tenant audit logs and downloadable urls expire after configurable TTL.
6) SLA: Enterprise customers receive initial acknowledgement within 24 hours for submitted requests.
7) Security review sign-off present (security_review_required=true) and redaction rules are validated by Security before launch.
